scored_papers.title: A Fibre-Integrated SPDC Heralded Single-Photon Source Using Zn-Indiffused PPLN Ridge Waveguides at Telecom Wavelengths
scored_papers.abstract: We demonstrate a fully fibre-integrated source of broadband polarisation-entangled photon pairs at telecom wavelengths based on a commercially available Zn-indiffused MgO:PPLN ridge waveguide incorporated within a Sagnac interferometer. Operating across the full degenerate SPDC spectrum using pump-suppression filtering only, the source exhibits a measured bandwidth of approximately 67 nm. Strong non-classical correlations are observed, with an average two-photon interference visibility of 96.9 +/- 0.2 %, a fidelity to the Phi + Bell state of 78.1 %, and a CHSH Bell parameter of S = 2.501 +/- 0.005. We further explore the effect of increasing source brightness on Bell-state performance, revealing the limitations of accidental-corrected metrics in high-flux operating regimes.
scored_papers.reason: 🔦 SPDC の偏光もつれ光子対源で二光子干渉 visibility 96.9%！高輝度で accidental 補正した指標が破綻する話もあって、実験の見積もりに効きそう🧪✨
scored_papers.summary: Zn拡散PPLNリッジ導波路をSagnac干渉計に組んだ完全ファイバ化光源📡 帯域約67 nm、Φ+忠実度78.1%、CHSH S=2.501。輝度とBell性能のトレードオフも測定
